title: cyperus ovularis var. americanus
intro: Cyperus ovularis var. americanus, commonly known as American umbrella sedge, is a type of sedge plant that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. American umbrella sedge is known to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and exhibit analgesic and anti-arthritic effects. The bioactive constituents of American umbrella sedge include sesquiterpenes, phenolic compounds, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
